description: Doc-surface line counts of scheduling. The prior wave slimmed docs/spec.md to 871 lines; the FT-E loop-redesign reconciliation re-anchored it to 900; the self-healing known-port adapter-map migration re-anchored it to 936; the issue/PR-named dispatch-description cycle re-anchored spec.md to 944; the stale/incompatible tick-checkpoint discard-and-fresh cycle re-anchored spec.md to 983; the per_item dispatch-description-always-names-the-ref cycle re-anchored spec.md to 993; the advisory-REVIEW always_ok cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1008; the immediate-refire cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1069; the pool-based-refire + integrate/refire-observability cycle (a real behavior cycle, §3.3.3/§3.9.1) additively re-anchors spec.md to 1090 (contract.md keeps its 96-line baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate; it is now 100 after the additive contract updates), the same way #244 retired the deletion wave's contract-unchanged gate. The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are NOT larger than these re-anchored baselines and that the load-bearing tokens survived. The historical pre-wave spec baseline (commit 7a42f9c) was 871; FT-E was 900.
